name: When should I consider re-texturing my stucco?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider re-texturing my stucco?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider re-texturing your stucco if you notice extensive cracking, chipping, or bubbling, which can indicate underlying moisture issues or material fatigue. Significant discoloration or an outdated appearance are also common reasons for a re-texture, as it can refresh your home's curb appeal. If you're undertaking a major renovation or simply want a new look for your exterior, re-texturing provides an opportunity to update your home's aesthetic and potentially improve its protective qualities. A professional assessment can determine the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Re-texture stucco for extensive cracking, chipping, bubbling, significant discoloration, an outdated appearance, or as part of a renovation.
